correctness.rationale: Two exact discounted hitting recurrences follow from simple random walk on K_{a,b}, with determinant positive for all 0<lambda<1. Both all-source/entire-part boundaries and tau>=lambda regimes are accounted for. For 0<tau<lambda the smaller potential in s>=t is bounded by the concave function f(t)=(C-At)/(B(1-t)); evaluating its allowed endpoints gives the global lower bound. One-sided/balanced rounding gives a matching ceiling or plus-one and the K3,4 rational case proves plus-one sharp. An independent Gauss-Jordan calculation on 1860 explicit pinned instances, 11160 threshold checks, and 4770 relaxation-grid tests passed. These finite checks corroborate but do not prove the universal claim.

originality.rationale: The first public mathematical source defining the uniform discounted floor, arXiv:2609.31535v1 (2026-09-25), includes arbitrary-graph formulations, a spider algorithm and exact results for stars and complete graphs but not the explicit biclique bang–bang threshold, the aspect-ratio law, the all-placement binomial polynomial or the sharp additive-one bound. The latter conclusions were proved independently, not copied from an existing case of the published theorem. Relevant group-hitting-query work asks a different question (evaluation/ranking), and the 2014 random-walk domination formulation optimizes aggregate finite-horizon measures. Searches of equivalent terminology and nearest indexed results did not identify covering claims. The star restriction a=1 is acknowledged as prior; no novelty asserted for that case alone. Originality is scoped to genuinely unbalanced K_{a,b} with 2<=a<b; the balanced and star families are excluded, so the stated unequal-size aspect-ratio phase and sharp integrality classification are not merely those boundary specializations.
residual_risks: A mathematically equivalent biclique source-placement theorem may be unindexed or published under alternative penalized-hitting or stopped-walk terminology.
Full content of Guo et al. 2024 and Li et al. 2014 was not inspected; available abstracts show different optimization objectives but cannot exclude ancillary calculations.

The universal exact MILP of the 2026 source can in principle generate finite biclique values; the contribution assessed here is the closed symbolic phase and sharp rounding, not computational decidability.
The equal-part and star specializations are excluded, while equivalent unindexed unequal-part formulas remain possible.

value.rationale: The minimum-source uniform discounted hitting floor was explicitly introduced as a natural placement optimization in the motivating 2026 work. A two-mechanism global optimization law for every genuinely unequal complete bipartite order with both parts nontrivial and all real lambda,tau, with the threshold-independent b/a=1/lambda switch, is a structural and interpretable design principle beyond brute pinned-matrix evaluation. The sharp K-or-K+1 integrality theorem and exact labeled optimizer-count polynomial identify when fractional balancing is misleading. No general downstream theorem is assumed or required; the mathematical motivation is specific to minimum verified-source placement on a standard graph class.
